role: @Observable sub-object of WorkoutRecorder holding live motion metrics (distance, elevation gain, live track, steps, cadence, power, foot-pod flag) so map/stat views do not re-render on HR beats.
toplevel: Stored defaults all zero/empty/nil/false. Instance is WorkoutRecorder.motion (WorkoutRecorder.swift:62); writers are the ticker (mirrorMotionAndPowerSensors) and reset().

units.does: Sets distanceMeters 0, elevationGainMeters 0, liveTrack [], stepCount 0, cadenceStepsPerMin nil, powerWatts nil, footPodActive false. Called by resetRecorderStateAfterStop (WorkoutRecorder+Stop.swift:231).

flags.text: Type doc names the writers as `WorkoutRecorder.incrementalBackupTick` + `resetMetrics`; no `resetMetrics` exists in the repo (the reset is this `reset()`, called only from resetRecorderStateAfterStop).
